name: First-Order Elimination
expr: Ct = C0·e^(-kt)

name: Zero-Order Elimination
expr: Ct = C0 - k0·t

name: AUC (Trapezoidal Method)
expr: AUC = Σ[(C1+C2)/2]·Δt

name: AUC (Extrapolated to Infinity)
expr: AUC∞ = AUC_last + Clast/k

name: Peak Plasma Concentration (Cmax)
expr: observed maximum plasma concentration after a dose

name: Time to Peak Concentration (Tmax)
expr: time at which Cmax occurs after administration

name: Steady-State Concentration
expr: Css = Dose/(Cl·τ)

name: Time to Reach Steady State
expr: concept: approximately 4-5 elimination half-lives

name: Loading Dose
expr: LD = Vd × Target Concentration

name: Maintenance Dose
expr: MD = Css × Cl × τ

name: Elimination Rate
expr: Rate = k × C

name: Fraction Eliminated
expr: Fraction = 1 - e^(-kt)

name: Fraction Remaining
expr: Fraction = e^(-kt)

name: One-Compartment Model Equation
expr: C(t) = (Dose/Vd)·e^(-kt)

name: Two-Compartment Model
expr: concept: distribution and elimination phases are modeled separately

name: Absorption Rate Constant (ka)
expr: concept: governs the rate at which drug enters systemic circulation

name: Peak-Trough Fluctuation
expr: Fluctuation = (Cmax-Cmin)/Cavg

name: Mean Residence Time
expr: MRT = AUMC/AUC

name: Apparent Volume of Distribution
expr: Vd = Dose/C0

name: Flip-Flop Kinetics
expr: concept: occurs when the absorption rate is slower than the elimination rate

name: Nonlinear (Michaelis-Menten) Elimination
expr: Rate = (Vmax·C)/(Km+C)

name: Superposition Principle (Multiple Dosing)
expr: concept: total concentration from repeated doses equals the sum of individual dose contributions

name: Total Body Clearance
expr: Cl = Dose/AUC

name: Renal Clearance
expr: ClR = (U×V)/P

name: Hepatic Clearance
expr: Cl_H = Q_H × E_H

name: Extraction Ratio
expr: E = (Ca-Cv)/Ca

name: Clearance from Vd and k
expr: Cl = k × Vd

name: Creatinine Clearance (Cockcroft-Gault)
expr: ClCr = [(140-Age)×Weight]/(72×SCr), ×0.85 if female

name: Renal Clearance via GFR
expr: ClR ≈ GFR × fu (for filtered drugs)

name: Flow-Limited Hepatic Clearance
expr: concept: Cl_H approaches Q_H for high-extraction-ratio drugs

name: Capacity-Limited Hepatic Clearance
expr: concept: Cl_H approaches fu×Cl_int for low-extraction-ratio drugs

name: Total Clearance (Multiple Organs)
expr: Cl_total = Cl_renal + Cl_hepatic + Cl_other

name: Dialysis Clearance
expr: Cl_dialysis = (Qd×(Ca-Cd))/Ca

name: Elimination Half-Life from Clearance
expr: t½ = 0.693×Vd/Cl

name: Fraction Unbound
expr: fu = Cu/Ctotal

name: Free Drug Clearance
expr: Cl_u = Cl/fu

name: Renal Excretion Rate
expr: dAe/dt = ClR × C

name: Amount Excreted Unchanged
expr: Ae = ClR × AUC

name: First-Pass Metabolism
expr: concept: hepatic metabolism that reduces bioavailability before systemic circulation

name: Hepatic Extraction Ratio Classification
expr: concept: classified as high (>0.7), intermediate, or low (<0.3)

name: Intrinsic Clearance
expr: Cl_int = Vmax/Km (at low substrate concentration)

name: Well-Stirred Model of Hepatic Clearance
expr: Cl_H = Q_H×(fu×Cl_int)/(Q_H+fu×Cl_int)

name: Parallel Tube Model
expr: concept: alternative hepatic clearance model assuming a concentration gradient along the sinusoid

name: Renal Reabsorption
expr: concept: process reducing the net excretion of a filtered drug

name: Tubular Secretion
expr: concept: active transport of a drug into the renal tubule beyond glomerular filtration

name: Anuric Patient Dose Adjustment
expr: concept: removes the renal clearance term, relying on non-renal clearance only

name: Elimination Rate Constant from Clearance
expr: k = Cl/Vd

name: Absolute Bioavailability
expr: F = (AUC_oral/Dose_oral)/(AUC_IV/Dose_IV)

name: Relative Bioavailability
expr: Frel = (AUC_test/Dose_test)/(AUC_ref/Dose_ref)

name: Bioequivalence Ratio (AUC)
expr: Ratio = AUC_test/AUC_ref

name: Bioequivalence Ratio (Cmax)
expr: Ratio = Cmax_test/Cmax_ref

name: Bioequivalence Acceptance Range
expr: concept: 90% confidence interval typically must fall within 80-125%

name: Rate of Absorption
expr: concept: reflected by comparison of Cmax and Tmax between formulations

name: Extent of Absorption
expr: concept: reflected by comparison of AUC between formulations

name: Dissolution Rate (Noyes-Whitney)
expr: dC/dt = (DA/h)(Cs-C)

name: Partition Coefficient
expr: logP = log(Coil/Cwater)

name: Distribution Coefficient (LogD)
expr: concept: partition coefficient adjusted for ionization at a given pH

name: Henderson-Hasselbalch Equation (Acid)
expr: pH = pKa + log([A⁻]/[HA])

name: Henderson-Hasselbalch Equation (Base)
expr: pH = pKa + log([B]/[BH⁺])

name: Percent Ionized
expr: concept: fraction ionized derived from the relationship between pH and pKa

name: Dissolution Efficiency
expr: concept: area under the dissolution curve relative to the total possible area

name: Difference Factor (f1)
expr: f1 = [Σ|Rt-Tt|/ΣRt] × 100

name: Biopharmaceutics Classification System
expr: concept: classifies drugs by aqueous solubility and intestinal permeability

name: Permeability Coefficient
expr: concept: rate at which a drug crosses a biological membrane

name: Food Effect on Bioavailability
expr: concept: meal composition can alter the rate and/or extent of drug absorption

name: First-Pass Bioavailability Loss
expr: F = 1 - (fraction metabolized before reaching systemic circulation)

name: Sink Conditions (Dissolution Testing)
expr: concept: maintaining dissolution medium concentration well below saturation solubility

name: Intrinsic Dissolution Rate
expr: concept: rate of dissolution per unit surface area under standardized conditions

name: Bioavailability from Multiple-Dose Data
expr: F = (AUCss_oral×τ_IV)/(AUCss_IV×τ_oral)

name: Relative Bioavailability from Cmax
expr: F_Cmax = Cmax_test/Cmax_ref

name: In Vitro-In Vivo Correlation
expr: concept: relationship linking in vitro dissolution data to in vivo bioavailability

name: Apparent Volume of Distribution
expr: Vd = Dose/C0

name: Vd from Clearance and k
expr: Vd = Cl/k

name: Vd (Area Method)
expr: Vd(area) = Dose/(k×AUC)

name: Vd at Steady State
expr: Vd,ss = Dose×AUMC/AUC²

name: Vd (Extrapolated Method)
expr: concept: calculated from the back-extrapolated concentration C0

name: Two-Compartment Distribution Phase
expr: concept: rapid initial decline reflecting drug distribution into tissues

name: Two-Compartment Elimination Phase
expr: concept: slower terminal decline reflecting overall drug elimination

name: Alpha Phase Rate Constant
expr: concept: governs the rate of decline during the distribution phase

name: Beta Phase Rate Constant
expr: concept: governs the rate of decline during the terminal elimination phase

name: Central Compartment Volume (V1)
expr: concept: represents plasma and highly perfused tissues

name: Peripheral Compartment Volume (V2)
expr: concept: represents less well-perfused tissue compartments

name: Intercompartmental Clearance
expr: concept: rate of drug transfer between the central and peripheral compartments

name: Physiologically-Based PK Model
expr: concept: compartments represent actual organs and tissues linked by blood flow

name: Tissue:Plasma Partition Coefficient
expr: concept: ratio governing a drug's distribution into a specific tissue

name: Protein Binding Effect on Vd
expr: concept: highly protein-bound drugs tend to show a smaller apparent Vd

name: Vd for Highly Lipophilic Drugs
expr: concept: tend to have a large Vd due to extensive tissue distribution

name: Vd for Hydrophilic Drugs
expr: concept: tend to have a small Vd, remaining mainly in plasma and extracellular fluid

name: Redistribution
expr: concept: drug moves from the central to peripheral compartment, lowering plasma concentration

name: Flip-Flop Model
expr: concept: a slower absorption than elimination rate alters the apparent PK profile

name: Inter-Compartmental Rate Constants (k12, k21)
expr: concept: describe the rates of drug transfer between compartments

name: Loading Dose from Vd
expr: LD = Vd × Target Concentration

name: Vd Adjustment in Obesity
expr: concept: lipophilic drugs may require a weight-based Vd adjustment

name: Vd Adjustment in Edema/Ascites
expr: concept: expanded fluid compartments increase apparent Vd for hydrophilic drugs

name: Total Body Water Reference
expr: concept: approximately 60% of body weight in an average adult

name: Non-Compartmental Analysis
expr: concept: estimates PK parameters directly from concentration-time data without assuming a specific model

name: Dose per Body Weight
expr: Dose = mg/kg × Weight(kg)

name: Dose per Body Surface Area
expr: Dose = mg/m² × BSA

name: Body Surface Area (Mosteller Formula)
expr: BSA = √[(Height(cm)×Weight(kg))/3600]

name: Body Surface Area (DuBois Formula)
expr: BSA = 0.007184×Height(cm)^0.725×Weight(kg)^0.425

name: Percentage Strength to mg
expr: mg = (%w/v)×10×Volume(mL)

name: Milliequivalents Calculation
expr: mEq = (mg×valence)/Molecular Weight

name: Milliosmoles Calculation
expr: mOsm = (mg/MW)×number of particles×1000

name: Dilution Formula
expr: C1V1 = C2V2

name: Alligation Alternate Method
expr: concept: determines proportions needed to mix two strengths to obtain a desired strength

name: Specific Gravity Calculation
expr: SG = weight of substance/weight of an equal volume of water

name: Density-Based Weight/Volume Conversion
expr: Weight = Density × Volume

name: Days' Supply Calculation
expr: Days' Supply = Total Quantity/Daily Dose

name: Total Quantity to Dispense
expr: Quantity = Daily Dose × Days' Supply

name: Tablet Splitting Dose
expr: Dose per Half = Tablet Strength/2

name: Reconstitution Concentration
expr: Concentration = Total Drug Amount/Total Volume After Reconstitution

name: Percent Error in Weighing
expr: %Error = (|Desired-Actual|/Desired)×100

name: Least Weighable Quantity
expr: concept: smallest quantity that can be measured within an acceptable error tolerance

name: Aliquot Method
expr: concept: dilutes a small quantity into a larger, more accurately measurable one

name: Dose Rounding for Administration
expr: concept: rounding a calculated dose to the nearest available formulation strength

name: Maximum Daily Dose Check
expr: concept: verifying a regimen does not exceed the established maximum safe daily dose

name: Loading Plus Maintenance Regimen
expr: concept: an initial larger dose followed by smaller doses to maintain steady state

name: Dose Conversion Between Salt Forms
expr: Dose_salt = Dose_base × (MW_salt/MW_base)

name: International Units to Mass Conversion
expr: concept: uses a drug-specific conversion factor between IU and mg

name: Dosing Frequency from Half-Life
expr: concept: interval chosen relative to elimination half-life to maintain therapeutic levels

name: Young's Rule (Pediatric)
expr: Child Dose = [Age/(Age+12)] × Adult Dose

name: Clark's Rule (Pediatric)
expr: Child Dose = [Weight(lb)/150] × Adult Dose

name: Fried's Rule (Infant)
expr: Infant Dose = [Age(months)/150] × Adult Dose

name: BSA-Based Pediatric Dose
expr: Child Dose = (BSA_child/1.73) × Adult Dose

name: mg/kg/day Pediatric Dosing
expr: Total Daily Dose = mg/kg/day × Weight(kg)

name: Divided Dose Calculation
expr: Dose per Administration = Total Daily Dose/Number of Doses

name: Neonatal Dose Adjustment
expr: concept: accounts for immature renal and hepatic function reducing clearance

name: Geriatric Renal Dose Adjustment
expr: concept: uses estimated creatinine clearance to adjust dose or interval

name: Geriatric Dose Reduction Factor
expr: concept: empiric percentage reduction for narrow-therapeutic-index drugs in the elderly

name: Ideal Body Weight (Male, Devine Formula)
expr: IBW = 50 + 2.3×(Height(in)-60)

name: Adjusted Body Weight
expr: AdjBW = IBW + 0.4×(Actual Weight - IBW)

name: Lean Body Weight
expr: concept: estimate of body weight excluding fat mass, used for certain drug dosing

name: Pediatric Maintenance Fluid (Holliday-Segar)
expr: 100 mL/kg for first 10 kg + 50 mL/kg for next 10 kg + 20 mL/kg thereafter

name: Pediatric Maximum Single Dose Cap
expr: concept: weight-based dose calculated but capped at the adult maximum dose

name: Corrected Gestational Age Dosing
expr: concept: neonatal dosing adjusted using age since conception rather than birth

name: Geriatric Polypharmacy Risk
expr: concept: estimates cumulative risk arising from multiple concurrent medications

name: Renal Interval Extension Method
expr: concept: lengthens the dosing interval rather than reducing the dose in renal impairment

name: Child-Pugh Score (Hepatic Dose Adjustment)
expr: concept: stratifies dose reduction based on the severity of liver dysfunction

name: Weight-Based Pediatric Loading Dose
expr: LD = Vd(mL/kg) × Weight(kg) × Target Concentration

name: Percentage of Adult Dose by Age Group
expr: concept: general pediatric dosing guideline scaling dose by developmental stage

name: Frailty-Adjusted Dosing
expr: concept: geriatric dose modification based on a frailty index rather than age alone

name: Growth-Adjusted Pediatric Redosing
expr: concept: periodic dose recalculation as a child's weight increases over time

name: Renal Dosing Nomogram
expr: concept: chart-based adjustment of dose or interval according to creatinine clearance

name: Maximum Recommended Pediatric Daily Dose
expr: concept: verifies total daily dose does not exceed the defined pediatric ceiling

name: IV Flow Rate (mL/hr)
expr: Rate = Total Volume/Total Time(hr)

name: Drop Rate (gtt/min)

name: Infusion Time from Rate
expr: Time = Volume/Rate

expr: Rate(mL/hr) = [Dose(mcg/kg/min)×Weight(kg)×60]/Concentration(mcg/mL)

name: mg/min Infusion Rate
expr: Rate(mL/hr) = [Dose(mg/min)×60]/Concentration(mg/mL)

name: Units/hr Infusion Rate (e.g., Heparin)
expr: Rate(mL/hr) = Dose(units/hr)/Concentration(units/mL)

name: Concentration from Amount and Volume
expr: Concentration = Drug Amount/Total Volume

name: Total Infusion Volume
expr: Volume = Rate × Time

name: Loading Dose Infusion Time
expr: concept: time needed to infuse a bolus loading dose at a defined maximum rate

name: Maintenance Infusion Rate
expr: Rate = Css × Cl

name: Percent Solution to mg/mL
expr: mg/mL = % × 10

name: Osmolarity of IV Solution
expr: mOsm/L = (mg/L ÷ MW) × number of particles × 1000

name: Tonicity Classification
expr: concept: compares solution osmolarity to plasma to classify as isotonic, hypotonic, or hypertonic

name: Fluid Deficit Calculation
expr: Deficit(L) = %Dehydration × Weight(kg)/100

name: Adult Maintenance Fluid Rate
expr: concept: standard estimated daily adult fluid requirement

name: Free Water Deficit
expr: FWD = TBW×[(Na_measured/140)-1]

name: Sodium Correction Rate Limit
expr: concept: maximum safe rate of serum sodium correction to avoid osmotic demyelination

name: Potassium Replacement Rate Limit
expr: concept: maximum safe peripheral IV infusion rate for potassium chloride

name: TPN Caloric Calculation
expr: concept: sums caloric contributions from dextrose, lipids, and protein

name: Dextrose Infusion Rate (GIR)
expr: GIR = (Dextrose%×Rate(mL/hr)×0.167)/Weight(kg)

name: Y-Site Compatibility Consideration
expr: concept: assesses whether two IV drugs can be safely co-infused

name: Priming Volume Calculation
expr: concept: tubing volume that must be filled before medication reaches the patient

name: Overfill Volume Adjustment
expr: concept: accounts for extra fluid volume present in IV bags beyond the labeled amount

name: Infusion Pump Rate Rounding
expr: concept: rounds a calculated rate to the nearest value the pump can accurately deliver

name: Bolus Dose Push Time
expr: concept: minimum time over which an IV push dose should be administered for safety

name: Alligation Alternate
expr: concept: method for calculating proportions when mixing two concentrations to obtain an intermediate one

name: Percentage Weight-in-Volume (%w/v)
expr: grams of solute per 100 mL of solution

name: Percentage Weight-in-Weight (%w/w)
expr: grams of solute per 100 g of preparation

name: Percentage Volume-in-Volume (%v/v)
expr: mL of solute per 100 mL of solution

name: Specific Gravity Conversion
expr: Weight(g) = Volume(mL) × Specific Gravity

name: Parts Per Million (ppm)
expr: ppm = mg solute per kg of solution (approx. mg/L)

name: Isotonicity Adjustment (Sodium Chloride Equivalent)
expr: concept: amount of NaCl equivalent needed to render a solution isotonic

name: Isotonicity by Freezing Point Depression
expr: concept: adjusts tonicity based on known freezing point depression data

name: Milliequivalent Weight

name: Molarity
expr: M = moles of solute/liters of solution

name: Molality
expr: m = moles of solute/kg of solvent

name: Normality
expr: N = equivalents of solute/liters of solution

name: Trituration Ratio

name: Geometric Dilution
expr: concept: technique for uniformly mixing a small quantity of drug into a larger quantity of diluent

expr: Drug Amount = (Total Molds × Mold Capacity) - Displacement Adjustment

name: Capsule Filling Calculation
expr: concept: determines total powder weight needed per capsule including excipients

name: Percentage Error in Compounding
expr: %Error = (|Theoretical-Actual|/Theoretical)×100

name: Beyond-Use Date Assignment
expr: concept: expiration period assigned to a compounded preparation based on formulation type

name: Emulsion HLB Value
expr: concept: hydrophilic-lipophilic balance value used to select appropriate emulsifiers

name: Required HLB of Oil Phase
expr: concept: weighted average HLB needed based on the oil components in a formulation

name: Ointment/Cream Base Selection
expr: concept: choice of base based on desired drug release and skin condition

name: Levigation
expr: concept: technique of reducing particle size using a small amount of liquid before incorporation

name: Punch Method (Capsule Compounding)
expr: concept: manual technique for filling capsules with compounded powder

name: Percentage Yield in Compounding
expr: %Yield = (Actual Yield/Theoretical Yield)×100

name: Dilution Formula
expr: C1V1 = C2V2

name: Serial Dilution Factor
expr: Final Concentration = Initial Concentration/(Dilution Factor)^n

name: Parts Per Billion (ppb)
expr: ppb ≈ mg solute per million liters of solution

name: Concentration from Mass and Volume
expr: C = Mass/Volume

name: Molar Concentration from Mass
expr: M = (Mass/MW)/Volume(L)

name: Equivalent Concentration Conversion
expr: mEq/mL = (mg/mL × Valence)/Molecular Weight

name: Titration Endpoint Calculation
expr: concept: volume of titrant required to neutralize a known quantity of analyte

name: Buffer Concentration (Henderson-Hasselbalch)
expr: concept: ratio of conjugate base to acid needed to achieve a target pH

name: Working Solution Preparation
expr: concept: diluting a concentrated stock to the concentration needed for use

name: Reconstitution Dilution Volume

name: Concentration After Mixing Two Solutions

name: Percentage Recovery

name: Limit of Detection
expr: concept: lowest concentration of an analyte reliably distinguishable from background

name: Limit of Quantification
expr: concept: lowest concentration that can be quantified with acceptable precision and accuracy

name: Standard Curve Concentration Estimation
expr: Concentration = (Response - Intercept)/Slope

name: Sequential Dilution Series
expr: concept: stepwise dilutions each derived from the previous, typically by a constant factor

name: Osmolar Concentration from Dissociation
expr: mOsm/L = Molarity × number of particles × 1000

name: Drop-Based Concentration Estimation
expr: concept: estimates dose per drop from total drug amount and drops per volume

name: Concentration Ratio for Batch Scaling
expr: concept: scales ingredient quantities to prepare a different batch size

name: Log Dilution Series
expr: concept: dilutions spaced evenly on a logarithmic scale, used for assay standard curves

name: Creatinine Clearance (Cockcroft-Gault)
expr: ClCr = [(140-Age)×Weight(kg)]/(72×SCr), ×0.85 if female

name: MDRD eGFR Equation
expr: concept: estimates GFR using serum creatinine, age, sex, and race-based coefficients

name: CKD-EPI eGFR Equation
expr: concept: refined GFR estimation equation with improved accuracy at higher GFR values

name: Dosing Interval Extension Method
expr: concept: lengthens the dosing interval while keeping the dose constant

name: Dose Reduction Method
expr: concept: reduces the dose while keeping the dosing interval constant

name: Combined Dose and Interval Adjustment
expr: concept: modifies both dose and interval for renal impairment

name: Hemodialysis Supplemental Dose
expr: concept: additional dose given after dialysis to replace the drug removed

name: Peritoneal Dialysis Clearance Contribution
expr: concept: drug removal contribution from peritoneal dialysis considered in dosing

name: CRRT Dosing Adjustment
expr: concept: accounts for continuous extracorporeal clearance in continuous renal replacement therapy

name: CKD Staging by eGFR
expr: concept: classifies chronic kidney disease severity by estimated GFR range

name: Anuria/Oliguria Dose Adjustment
expr: concept: dosing based on non-renal clearance when urine output is minimal

name: Fractional Excretion of Sodium (FENa)
expr: FENa = [(Urine Na × Plasma Cr)/(Plasma Na × Urine Cr)]×100

name: Urine Output-Based Fluid Replacement
expr: concept: matches fluid replacement volume to measured urine output

name: Estimated Creatinine Generation Rate
expr: concept: factor used in certain GFR estimation methods

name: BSA-Normalized GFR
expr: GFR_normalized = (GFR × 1.73)/Patient BSA

expr: Cl_CRRT = Ultrafiltration Rate × Sieving Coefficient

name: Nephrotoxic Drug Monitoring Threshold
expr: concept: defined trough/peak levels used to minimize renal toxicity risk

name: Loading Dose in Renal Impairment
expr: concept: typically unchanged since it is based on Vd rather than clearance

name: Maintenance Dose Adjustment in Renal Impairment
expr: MD_adjusted = MD_normal × (Cl_patient/Cl_normal)

name: Steady-State Assumption for Cockcroft-Gault
expr: concept: validity of the equation depends on stable, non-fluctuating renal function

name: Obesity-Adjusted Creatinine Clearance
expr: concept: uses adjusted body weight in the Cockcroft-Gault equation for obese patients

name: Pediatric Schwartz Formula
expr: ClCr = (k × Height(cm))/SCr

name: Renal Impairment Classification by ClCr
expr: concept: mild, moderate, and severe categories based on clearance ranges

name: Dialyzability of a Drug
expr: concept: determined by molecular weight, protein binding, and volume of distribution

name: Dose-Response Relationship
expr: concept: describes how drug effect changes as dose increases

name: EC50
expr: concept: concentration producing 50% of the maximal drug effect

name: Emax Model
expr: E = (Emax×C)/(EC50+C)

name: Hill Equation
expr: E = (Emax×C^n)/(EC50^n+C^n)

name: Therapeutic Index
expr: TI = TD50/ED50 (or LD50/ED50)

name: Therapeutic Window
expr: concept: range of concentrations between the minimum effective and minimum toxic level

name: Potency
expr: concept: amount of drug required to produce a given effect; a lower EC50 means higher potency

name: Efficacy
expr: concept: the maximum effect a drug can produce, regardless of dose

name: Agonist
expr: concept: a substance that binds a receptor and activates a biological response

name: Antagonist
expr: concept: a substance that binds a receptor without activating it, blocking agonist action

name: Competitive Antagonism
expr: concept: shifts the agonist dose-response curve rightward, reducing its apparent potency

name: Non-Competitive Antagonism
expr: concept: reduces the maximal effect regardless of agonist concentration

name: Partial Agonist
expr: concept: produces a submaximal response even at full receptor occupancy

name: Receptor Occupancy Theory
expr: concept: drug effect is proportional to the fraction of receptors occupied

name: Schild Equation
expr: concept: quantifies antagonist potency from the shift in the agonist dose-response curve

name: Dissociation Constant (Kd)
expr: concept: the concentration at which half of the receptors are bound by the ligand

name: Median Effective Dose (ED50)
expr: concept: the dose producing a defined effect in 50% of a population

name: Median Lethal Dose (LD50)
expr: concept: the dose lethal in 50% of a population, used as a toxicology reference

name: Quantal Dose-Response Curve
expr: concept: plots the percentage of a population responding versus dose

name: Tolerance
expr: concept: decreased drug response following repeated administration

name: Tachyphylaxis
expr: concept: rapid decrease in response after repeated doses over a short period

name: Synergism
expr: concept: the combined effect of two drugs is greater than the sum of their individual effects

name: Additive Effect
expr: concept: the combined effect of two drugs equals the sum of their individual effects

name: Receptor Reserve
expr: concept: a situation where the maximal effect is achieved without occupying all receptors

name: Down-Regulation of Receptors
expr: concept: a reduction in receptor number following chronic agonist exposure

name: Half-Lives to Reach Steady State
expr: concept: approximately 4-5 elimination half-lives

name: Half-Lives to Near-Complete Elimination
expr: concept: approximately 4-5 half-lives eliminate roughly 97% of a drug

name: Enzyme Inhibition Interaction
expr: concept: increases the plasma concentration of a substrate drug by reducing its metabolism

name: Enzyme Induction Interaction
expr: concept: decreases the plasma concentration of a substrate drug by increasing its metabolism

name: Competitive Metabolic Interaction
expr: concept: two drugs compete for the same metabolic enzyme

name: Protein Binding Displacement Interaction
expr: concept: one drug displaces another from plasma protein binding sites, raising the free fraction

name: Additive Pharmacodynamic Interaction
expr: concept: combined drugs produce an additive therapeutic or adverse effect

name: Synergistic Pharmacodynamic Interaction
expr: concept: combined drugs produce a greater-than-additive effect

name: Antagonistic Pharmacodynamic Interaction
expr: concept: one drug reduces the effect of another

name: QT Interval Prolongation Risk
expr: concept: additive risk when combining multiple QT-prolonging drugs

name: Serotonin Syndrome Risk
expr: concept: additive serotonergic effect risk from combining serotonergic drugs

name: Cytochrome P450 Substrate Classification
expr: concept: identifies which enzyme primarily metabolizes a given drug

name: Half-Life Change with Enzyme Induction
expr: concept: shortened half-life resulting from increased metabolic clearance

name: Half-Life Change with Enzyme Inhibition
expr: concept: prolonged half-life resulting from decreased metabolic clearance

name: Time to New Steady State After Interaction
expr: concept: approximately 4-5 half-lives of the affected drug

name: Drug-Food Interaction
expr: concept: food altering the absorption, metabolism, or effect of a drug

name: Drug-Herb Interaction
expr: concept: an herbal product altering the pharmacokinetics or pharmacodynamics of a drug

name: P-Glycoprotein Interaction
expr: concept: an efflux transporter affecting drug absorption and distribution

name: Half-Life Estimation from Two Concentration Points
Interaction Severity Classification
expr: concept: categorizes drug interactions by clinical significance and required action

name: Time Course of Enzyme Induction
expr: concept: onset is delayed, requiring days to weeks for full effect

name: Time Course of Enzyme Inhibition
expr: concept: onset is often rapid, occurring within one dosing interval

name: Renal Transporter-Mediated Interaction
expr: concept: interaction altering the renal secretion or reabsorption of a drug

name: Cumulative Effect with Repeated Dosing
expr: concept: drug accumulation occurs when the dosing interval is shorter than needed for full elimination

name: Fick's First Law of Diffusion
expr: J = -D(dC/dx)

name: Passive Diffusion Rate
expr: concept: proportional to the concentration gradient across a membrane

name: Facilitated Diffusion
expr: concept: carrier-mediated transport down a concentration gradient requiring no energy

name: Active Transport
expr: concept: carrier-mediated transport against a concentration gradient requiring energy

name: Permeability Coefficient
expr: P = (D×K)/h

name: Membrane Partition Coefficient
expr: concept: ratio describing a drug's distribution between membrane and aqueous phase

name: Dissolution Rate (Noyes-Whitney Equation)
expr: dC/dt = (DA/h)(Cs-Ct)

name: Intrinsic Solubility
expr: concept: the solubility of the unionized form of a weak acid or base
